summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that integrates the SkillHub marketplace into settings so users can browse, install, enable/disable, update, and remove skills from the interface.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily an external-service integration and file-management utility that brings the SkillHub marketplace into DSH’s web UI. Its user-facing features focus on discovering skills, viewing metadata, downloading/installing bundles, toggling availability for AI requests, checking updates, and removing local skills. Because it communicates with a remote API and writes/reads local skill files and metadata, it presents moderate risk tied to network and filesystem operations, but no explicit sensitive-action expansion is indicated in the evidence.
